searchText: I'm trying to use Web3.js https://github.com/ethereum/web3.js to connect to any Ethereum node to get some data without running my own node. Is this possible? I tried some random nodes but none of them work. I keep getting an error `Error: connection not open on send` are there any general purpose demo nodes I can use to test? What IP/port should I use? Having to sync 500GB of blockchain history just to do some quick checks is overkill for me I just want to connect to some random testnet node, get the latest block (for example) and print the result Or is it possible to run some kind of light node which receives new blocks/transactions but doesn't hold onto the history? <@!520281592522997761> Infura has a free tier that is perfect for this use case. See https://infura.io (You are in the Eth2 section here, mind you. Web3js will not work with Eth2, so I am assuming that you want access to an Eth1 node.)
